pages.text: Grandma finished cutting rice. Bundles lay throughout the field.
Three bamboo tubes stood on the bank. Dingding watched: leaning together, they stayed up in wind.
"I will stand the bundles to dry." Grandma brought braided straw cord.
She tied one tight. "Tie and stand it like this."
This year's bundles were arm-thick. She stood one on the bank. A gust, and it fell.
She tightened the cord more. Snap! Two bundles lay at her feet.
She studied the cord. "Our old bundles stood well like this."
Dingding brought three bundles and leaned them against each other.
Another gust! Holding each other, all three stayed up.
Grandma leaned hers in threes too. Little mountains lined the bank.
